newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian Hansa Invest to advise St.Petersburg.
newsitem.headline: Estonian Hansa Invest to advise St.Petersburg.

text.p: Hansa Investments, part of Estonia's largest bank, Hansapank, on Wednesday signed an agreement with the St Peterburg property fund, under which the bank will advise on the city's privatization deals.
The Russian Federal Property Fund Administration of St Petersburg is going to privatise many big enterprises during the following year, Hansa Investments said in a statement.
The agency will sell up to 320 different companies such as the Port of St Petersburg, monopoly energy producer Lenenergo and heavy industry companies Nevski Zavod and Proletarski Zavod.
"It is a clear sign of the leading position Hansa Investments has reached in the Baltic region, including northwest Russia and the Baltic states," Joakim Helenius, Hansa Investments chairman, said.
Hansa Investments has branches in Tallinn, Riga, Vilnius and St Petersburg and representative offices in Helsinki and Prague.
